title: Data Matters Most: Auditing Social Bias in Contrastive Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring Max Skew (disparity) and Harm Rate (incidence) based on image-text cosine similarities for binary gender groups across crime, non-human, communion, and agency prompt categories using the FairFace and PATA datasets.

Measuring Max Skew (disparity) and Harm Rate (incidence) based on image-text cosine similarities for various ethno-racial groups across crime, non-human, communion, and agency prompt categories using the FairFace and PATA datasets.
